pages.text: The morning lake was still as a mirror. The sun was already hot on their backs. Grandpa and Nils set out their fishing rods.
Nils wanted to catch one fish. "Grilled fish for dinner!" A round float bobbed on the water. A bite would pull it under.
The float stayed still. Nils yawned. "Maybe there are no fish."
He laid his rod on the grass. Splash! He threw a stone.
Splash, splash. Big ripples spread, rocking the water beside Grandpa's float too.
Grandpa lifted his float. The bait was still there. "The fish swam far away."
The sun sank. The fish bucket was empty. Nils's tummy rumbled.
Grandpa cast his float again. "When the ripples settle, the fish come back."
Nils cast and sat still. Even his breaths were quiet. The water smoothed again.
Under went the float! "Caught one!" A silver fish flapped and flapped.
